message:
We all know that one person who seems gloriously over-prepared for anything life throws their way. You know, the friend who travels with a go-bag packed to the brim with snacks, first-aid supplies, and even a foldable solar charger. 😄 While it can feel a bit excessive at times, there’s something comforting about being ready for unexpected moments. 

Recently, we found ourselves in a minor emergency when the power went out during a storm. Thankfully, we had our own little stockpile of candles and flashlights, thanks to our over-prepared friend’s nudging. It reminded us that a little foresight can turn a stressful situation into a cozy adventure. 

What’s your favorite tip or trick for staying prepared? We’d love to hear your stories!
